meta.title: Pigmi — Texture Palette Editor
meta.description: Pigmi is a cross-platform editor for texture palettes, gradient atlases and PBR material maps, with ordered layers, Blender helpers and optional MCP automation.
meta.keywords: Pigmi, texture palette, palette editor, gradient atlas, PBR material maps, Blender addons, MCP, game development, 3D texturing

about.heading: ONE MATERIAL
about.subtitle: For everything you want
about.title: About
about.p1: PIGMI (formerly known as PalettePainter) is designed to simplify the creation and editing of texture palettes.
about.p2: Texture palettes are often used for low-poly models: they let you texture every model in a game with one small texture, such as 64 × 64 pixels.
about.p3: Feel free to use Metallic, Roughness, Clearcoat, Clearcoat Roughness and Emission in your materials.
about.p4: Set different values for each color cell and texture all your models with a single material.

features.heading: FEATURES
features.subtitle: You will like it!
features.easyDesc: Manage and search all your palette items. Adjust sizes, colors, gradient types and much more.
features.gameDesc: Pigmi exports PNG, WEBP and packed textures for games and realtime projects.
features.pbrDesc: Use Metallic, Roughness, Clearcoat, Clearcoat Roughness and Emission.
features.syncDesc: See changes instantly. Project JSON and enabled texture maps update automatically.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.i2: Set the texture size, snapping step, zoom and other settings
gettingStarted.i4: Enter a texture name and click Create, or select an existing texture from the list
gettingStarted.i5: Click Load and sync to open an existing texture, or Overwrite and sync to replace the previous file

controls.title: Base controls
controls.i1: Left-click empty canvas space to create an item, or left-click an item to select it
controls.i2: Right-click an item to remove it immediately; right-click empty space to clear the selection
controls.i3: LMB + drag moves items with grid snapping
controls.i4: Command/Ctrl + LMB adds items to or removes them from the multi-selection
controls.i5: Mouse wheel zooms toward the pointer; middle-button drag pans the canvas

layers.title: Layers
layers.desc: Organize palette items in an ordered tree with nested folders, multi-selection, visibility controls, isolation, renaming and drag-and-drop reordering. Copy and paste preserves folders, colors, materials and relative positions.
layers.a1: add or remove layers from the selection
layers.a3: isolate an item or folder branch

mcp.title: MCP automation
mcp.desc: Connect Pigmi to Codex or another compatible MCP client and edit the active document with natural-language requests. The bundled local server can inspect the layer tree, create and recolor items, move them into folders, edit PBR values, change export settings, save projects and undo changes.
mcp.i1: Open the plug tab in Pigmi and copy the generated connection command
mcp.i2: Run it once, restart Codex and open /mcp to confirm that Pigmi is enabled
mcp.i3: Keep Pigmi running with the required document open while the client works
mcp.i4: Changes are revision-checked and applied atomically to protect newer edits

mrc.title: MRC texture
mrc.desc: An MRC texture contains four maps in separate color channels. In Blender, set Alpha to Channel Packed so the alpha channel does not distort the colors.

mix.title: Texture mixing
mix.p1: Pigmi can combine an existing texture with a generated map. Put a PNG of the same resolution beside the project and name it like palette_albedo_mix.png.
mix.p2: Use roughness, metallic, clearcoat, clearcoat_roughness or mrc instead of albedo for the other maps.

addons.heading: BLENDER ADDONS
addons.subtitle: Three focused helpers for moving palette workflows into Blender.

uv.title: UV to Palette
uv.desc: Fits selected UVs into a palette cell, preserves island proportions when needed, and maps gradients across a mesh by a drawn path, radius, distance source or cavity / fake AO.
uv.a1: draw a gradient path over the mesh
uv.a2: pick an object as the distance-gradient source

highlighter.title: Highlighter
highlighter.desc: Paints vertex colors on a mesh with an editable palette, RGBA controls, quick white, black and transparent fills, adjustable radius and falloff, plus a non-destructive preview that can be saved or restored.
highlighter.a1: all actions are available in View3D → Tool → Pigmi: Highlighter
highlighter.a4: updates colors while the controls are adjusted

face.title: Face to Face
face.desc: Saves a selected mesh part from an active face or edge, then attaches it to a target face or edge. It can duplicate the part onto several targets and keeps rotation, flip, scale and selection-restore options in Blender's Adjust Last Operation panel.
face.a1: save the selected mesh part on the first call, then attach it on the next call

donations.heading: Donations and contacts
donations.text: Pigmi is completely free software. If you enjoy using it, you can support the project: donations help pay for hosting and development. You can also contact me with questions or bug reports.
